author: Centralking
body:
**Any Update on this appeal**?

Hi There, 

My name is Centralking and I got accused for anti knockback on the Avicus Network recently at 4:47 PM GMT by Aqoi. I'm not sure if this mod overlooked this situation as I wasn't using ANY hacks at all. I was just clicking rapidly and got accused for no reason. I believe a player accused me because just moments before this ban. He/she was annoying and kept calling me names what so ever. I didn't feel the need to report this player as I wasn't offended at all and after arguing with him/her for a few seconds, I felt to ignore. I don't have any evidence, as I didn't record it on the spot and thought his report mean't nothing. This is my first ban appeal, so please remove this accuse from my infractions as I've been a loyal player to the Avicus Network since Mczone and didn't have any intention to have "hacks". Just a note, some mods over exaggerate anti knockbacks on the Avicus Network even though the players are clicking rapidly and go up to high cps (clicks per second), maybe you should consider checking over your "trustful mods". 

Thanks for looking into this conflict,

Centralking

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Centralking,

Due to a lack of evidence, I will appeal this.
However, you must improve your behavior in-game, you have a lot of infractions and it's going to be easy to ban you again if you continue acting the way you do.

Regards,
Newcleus
Avicus Network Administrator
